    "chain": "Wembley < Old English *Wemba-lēah; lēah = clearing/wood; Wemba = personal name",

    "source": "Oxford Dictionary of English Place-Names",
    "confidence": 0.7

    "languages": ["de", "yi", "fro"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {

    "languages": ["en", "enm"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Wembley → 'by me, lew' (lew = shelter, warmth); also 'mewl, bey' (mewl = cry, bey = Turkish lord)",

    "confidence": 0.3
  },

    "operation": "notariqon",

    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "W = double V (victory, vulva); E = eye; M = water (mem); B = house (beth); L = ox-goad; Y = fork",
    "reading": "Double victory, eye, water, house, goad, fork — a path of seeing, shelter, and division",
    "languages": ["en", "he", "ph"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "W=6, E=5, M=4, B=2, L=3, Y=1 (A1Z26 reduced) → 6+5+4+2+3+1=21; 21 = XXI = cross of life",
    "reading": "Sum 21 — the cross of life, the key of the tarot's world, a completion of cycles",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Wembley ~ 'vemble' (Old Norse vembla) = to turn, twist; + 'ey' (Old Norse) = island",
    "reading": "Twisting island — a place of winding shores and turning tides, a labyrinth of water",
    "languages": ["en", "non"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  }
]
